listing.summary: The page is going to be VERY WIP as I try to figure out how to use the forums and of course all things are subject to change for the mod too but here is my new mod the Blue Moon Syndicate a combined group of privateers with less morals than a bounty hunter but are more reasonable than the average pirate.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a faction of privateers focused on high-tech armaments and built-in railguns, located northwest of the core worlds.

description:
Blue Moon Syndicate

The page is going to be VERY WIP as I try to figure out how to use the forums and of course all things are subject to change for the mod too but here is my new mod the Blue Moon Syndicate a combined group of privateers with less morals than a bounty hunter but are more reasonable than the average pirate.

There's a few anime portraits but that's as far as it goes and as of now the faction has a big focus on high tech armaments and built in railguns and has a system situated north west from the core worlds.

Once again do note that as it's a WIP so balance is going to be all over the place or just straight up broken.

Mods Required:
Lazylib
Graphicslib
Magiclib

The fleet!

Massive credits to Rico for helping me make the mod and making all the sprites which you can also commission here https://x.com/TandemCharge

Here is my stream for people who like to watch VTuber/Starsector content https://www.twitch.tv/codenamedferret
